examples.chinese: 爸爸很喜歡吃蛋糕，所以胖了三公斤。
examples.pinyin: Bàba hěn xǐhuān chī dàngāo, suǒyǐ pàng le sān gōngjīn.
examples.english: Dad really likes eating cake, so he has gained three kilograms.

examples.chinese: 我很想去看，可是我最近胖了五公斤，我怕衣服不好買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù kàn, kěshì wǒ zuìjìn pàng le wǔ gōngjīn, wǒ pà yīfu bù hǎo mǎi.
examples.english: I would like to check it out. But I have recently gained 5 kilograms, so I am worried that they don’t have my size.

examples.chinese: 妳胖了嗎？我不覺得啊，我跟妳一起去看。我也想去買今年夏天的新衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ pàng le ma? Wǒ bù juéde a, wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù kàn. Wǒ yě xiǎng qù mǎi jīnnián xiàtiān de xīn yīfu.
examples.english: Have you gained weight? I don’t think so. I can go check with you. I would like to buy the new summer collections.

examples.chinese: 我最近太胖了，應該多運動，少吃一點飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn tài pàng le, yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī yīdiǎn fàn.
examples.english: I've gotten too fat recently; I should exercise more and eat a little less food.

items.wordHook: A diner eats a ⺼(meat) plate 半(half) full each day → soon he is 胖(fat).

examples.chinese: 國安跟我說，他今天要去看醫生，他家附近有一家不錯的醫院。
examples.pinyin: Guó'ān gēn wǒ shuō, tā jīntiān yào qù kàn yīshēng, tā jiā fùjìn yǒu yì jiā búcuò de yīyuàn.
examples.english: Guoan told me he is going to see a doctor today; there is a nice hospital near his place.

examples.chinese: 我姊姊是這家醫院的護理師。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie shì zhè jiā yīyuàn de hùlǐshī.
examples.english: My older sister is a nurse at this hospital.

examples.chinese: 我生病了，媽媽今天要帶我去醫院看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shēngbìng le, māma jīntiān yào dài wǒ qù yīyuàn kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: I got sick; my mom is going to take me to the hospital to see a doctor today.

examples.chinese: 易先生從職場退休後，就加入了醫院的服務社團，繼續為社會貢獻一份力量。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng cóng zhíchǎng tuìxiū hòu, jiù jiārù le yīyuàn de fúwù shètuán, jìxù wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng.
examples.english: After Mr. Yi retired from the workplace, he joined the hospital's service club and continued to contribute his part to society.

examples.chinese: 這是博物館的網址，你可以先看看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì bówùguǎn de wǎngzhǐ, nǐ kěyǐ xiān kànkan.
examples.english: This is the museum's web address; you can take a look first.

examples.chinese: 這是往博物館的方向嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǎng bówùguǎn de fāngxiàng ma?
examples.english: Is this the direction to the museum?

examples.chinese: A:從學校到博物館去，應該往哪個方向走？ B:我看過地圖，應該往南走。
examples.pinyin: A: Cóng xuéxiào dào bówùguǎn qù, yīnggāi wǎng nǎge fāngxiàng zǒu? B: Wǒ kànguo dìtú, yīnggāi wǎng nán zǒu.
examples.english: A: From the school to the museum, which direction should we go? B: I've looked at the map; we should go south.

examples.chinese: 朋友推薦我去參觀這裡有名的博物館。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou tuījiàn wǒ qù cānguān zhèlǐ yǒumíng de bówùguǎn.
examples.english: A friend recommended that I visit the famous museum here.

examples.chinese: 這次的電腦展集合了各國有名的牌子，很值得參觀。老師要帶我們去參觀博物館，明天早上九點在校門口集合。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè cì de diànnǎo zhǎn jíhé le gè guó yǒumíng de páizi, hěn zhídé cānguān. 2. Lǎoshī yào dài wǒmen qù cānguān bówùguǎn, míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn zài xiàoménkǒu jíhé.
examples.english: 1. This computer exhibition gathered famous brands from various countries and is well worth visiting. 2. The teacher is taking us to visit the museum; we will gather at the school gate at 9 a.m. tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 為了配合藝術課程的內容，黃老師帶領學生去參觀博物館和美術館。
examples.pinyin: Wèile pèihé yìshù kèchéng de nèiróng, Huáng lǎoshī dàilǐng xuésheng qù cānguān bówùguǎn hé měishùguǎn.
examples.english: In order to fit the content of the art course, Teacher Huang led the students to visit the museum and the art gallery.

examples.chinese: 國家圖書館和博物館都是公共資源，任何人都可以使用。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā túshūguǎn hé bówùguǎn dōu shì gōnggòng zīyuán, rènhé rén dōu kěyǐ shǐyòng.
examples.english: National libraries and museums are public resources that anyone can use.

examples.chinese: 不少博物館裡的藝術品都是從古代保留到現代的，具有重要的時代意義。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo bówùguǎn lǐ de yìshùpǐn dōu shì cóng gǔdài bǎoliú dào xiàndài de, jùyǒu zhòngyào de shídài yìyì.
examples.english: Many artworks in museums have been preserved from ancient times to the present and have important historical significance.

examples.chinese: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin: 1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english: 1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 博物館內的藝術品價值都很高，不小心弄壞了可是要賠償不少錢的。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn nèi de yìshùpǐn jiàzhí dōu hěn gāo, bù xiǎoxīn nòng huài le kěshì yào péicháng bù shǎo qián de.
examples.english: The artworks in the museum are all very valuable; if you accidentally damage them, you will have to compensate a lot of money.

examples.chinese: 那家博物館平日展覽的物品很多，中多半與古代科技有關。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā bówùguǎn píngrì zhǎnlǎn de wùpǐn hěn duō, qízhōng duōbàn yǔ gǔdài kējì yǒu guān.
examples.english: That museum exhibits many items on weekdays, most of which are related to ancient technology.

examples.chinese: 國立博物館正在展覽公元三百年左右的古文物。
examples.pinyin: Guólì bówùguǎn zhèngzài zhǎnlǎn gōngyuán sānbǎi nián zuǒyòu de gǔ wénwù.
examples.english: The National Museum is currently exhibiting ancient artifacts from around 300 AD.

examples.chinese: 這家博物館曾因戰爭而被破壞，如今總算重新開放參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā bówùguǎn céng yīn zhànzhēng ér bèi pòhuài, rújīn zǒngsuàn chóngxīn kāifàng cānguān.
examples.english: This museum was once destroyed because of war, and nowadays it has finally reopened for visits.

examples.chinese: 這幅名畫每日吸引了上千位遊客前來博物館欣賞。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú míng huà měi rì xīyǐn le shàng qiān wèi yóukè qiánlái bówùguǎn xīnshǎng.
examples.english: This famous painting attracts over a thousand tourists each day to come to the museum to admire it.

examples.chinese: 為了提供學生良好的學習環境，學校改善了教室的設備，網路的速度也變快了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígōng xuéshēng liánghǎo de xuéxí huánjìng, xuéxiào gǎishàn le jiàoshì de shèbèi, wǎnglù de sùdù yě biàn kuài le.
examples.english: In order to provide students with a good learning environment, the school improved the classroom equipment, and the internet speed also became faster.

examples.chinese: 何老闆替公司建立了良好的制度，讓員工都能安心地工作。
examples.pinyin: Hé lǎobǎn tì gōngsī jiànlì le liánghǎo de zhìdù, ràng yuángōng dōu néng ānxīn de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Boss He established a good system for the company, allowing employees to work with peace of mind.

examples.chinese: 要維持社區良好的生活品質，就要從不亂丟垃圾、減少家庭噪音做起。
examples.pinyin: Yào wéichí shèqū liánghǎo de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, jiù yào cóng bù luàn diū lèsè, jiǎnshǎo jiātíng zàoyīn zuò qǐ.
examples.english: To maintain a good quality of life in the community, we must start by not littering and reducing household noise.

items.wordHook: Combining 良(good) and 好(good): 良好 means good, well.

examples.chinese: 管先生這段時間忙著布置新房子，希望給老婆一個又舒適又溫暖的家。
examples.pinyin: Guǎn xiānshēng zhè duàn shíjiān mángzhe bùzhì xīn fángzi, xīwàng gěi lǎopó yí ge yòu shūshì yòu wēnnuǎn de jiā.
examples.english: Mr. Guan has been busy decorating his new house during this time, hoping to give his wife a comfortable and warm home.

examples.chinese: 市長宣布明天因為颱風的風雨太大，不上班、不上課。
examples.pinyin: Shìzhǎng xuānbù míngtiān yīnwèi táifēng de fēngyǔ tài dà, bù shàngbān, bù shàngkè.
examples.english: The mayor announced that tomorrow, because the typhoon's wind and rain are too strong, there will be no work and no school.

examples.chinese: 在瀑布旁邊照相要看看周圍環境，別不小心掉下去了。
examples.pinyin: Zài pùbù pángbiān zhàoxiàng yào kànkan zhōuwéi huánjìng, bié bù xiǎoxīn diào xiàqù le.
examples.english: When taking photos next to a waterfall, you should look at the surrounding environment; don't accidentally fall down.

examples.chinese: 學校的布告欄總是隨著季節改變而有不同的設計。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de bùgàolán zǒngshì suízhe jìjié gǎibiàn ér yǒu bùtóng de shèjì.
examples.english: The school's bulletin board always has different designs as the seasons change.

examples.chinese: 公司的布告上貼著超市打折活動的廣告，感覺真的很怪。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de bùgào shàng tiēzhe chāoshì dǎzhé huódòng de guǎnggào, gǎnjué zhēn de hěn guài.
examples.english: The company's notice has an ad for a supermarket discount event posted on it; it feels really strange.

examples.chinese: 自從政府宣布石油、電費雙漲的作法以來，反對的民眾人數已近七成。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng zhèngfǔ xuānbù shíyóu, diànfèi shuāng zhǎng de zuòfǎ yǐlái, fǎnduì de mínzhòng rénshù yǐ jìn qī chéng.
examples.english: Since the government announced the policy of raising both oil and electricity prices, the number of people opposed has approached seventy percent.

examples.chinese: 期中測驗的結果明天就會公布，大家都很緊張。
examples.pinyin: Qīzhōng cèyàn de jiéguǒ míngtiān jiù huì gōngbù, dàjiā dōu hěn jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The results of the midterm exam will be announced tomorrow, and everyone is very nervous.

items.wordHook: A weaver's 𠂇(left hand) smooths out a fresh bolt of woven cotton 巾(cloth) ready to wear: 布(cloth).

examples.chinese: 有時候孩子不明白自己到底犯了什麼錯，父母應該好好跟他們溝通。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushíhou háizi bù míngbai zìjǐ dàodǐ fàn le shénme cuò, fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo gēn tāmen gōutōng.
examples.english: Sometimes children don't understand what mistake they have actually made; parents should communicate well with them.

examples.chinese: A:犯錯的人都可以請求原諒嗎？ B:得看他犯的是什麼錯，要是小小的錯，就該原諒吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Fàncuò de rén dōu kěyǐ qǐngqiú yuánliàng ma? B: Děi kàn tā fàn de shì shénme cuò, yàoshi xiǎoxiǎo de cuò, jiù gāi yuánliàng ba.
examples.english: A: Can everyone who makes a mistake ask for forgiveness? B: It depends on what mistake he made; if it's a small mistake, then he should be forgiven.

examples.chinese: 小李離婚後才知道失去老婆很痛苦，不過後悔也來不及了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ líhūn hòu cái zhīdào shīqù lǎopo hěn tòngkǔ, bùguò hòuhuǐ yě láibují le.
examples.english: Only after divorcing did Little Li realize that losing his wife is very painful, but it's too late to be regretful.

examples.chinese: 有好的投資機會就該好好掌握，不要等到事後才開始後悔。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu hǎo de tóuzī jīhuì jiù gāi hǎohǎo zhǎngwò, bùyào děngdào shìhòu cái kāishǐ hòuhuǐ.
examples.english: When there is a good investment opportunity, you should grasp it well; don't wait until afterwards to start regretting.

examples.chinese: 雖然他已經親自說了對不起，但還是很後悔做出那樣沒禮貌的行為，於是再度向各位道歉。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā yǐjīng qīnzì shuō le duìbuqǐ, dàn háishì hěn hòuhuǐ zuòchū nàyàng méi lǐmào de xíngwéi, yúshì zàidù xiàng gèwèi dàoqiàn.
examples.english: Although he has already personally said sorry, he still very much regrets having behaved so impolitely, so he once again apologizes to everyone.

examples.chinese: 你去書房把地板拖乾淨，好放我新買的地毯。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù shūfáng bǎ dìbǎn tuō gānjìng, hǎo fàng wǒ xīn mǎi de dìtǎn.
examples.english: Go to the study and mop the floor clean, so we can put down the new carpet I bought.

examples.chinese: A:這幾雙拖鞋我都喜歡，不知道怎麼挑選？ B:這容易，你挑雙便宜的就好。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhè jǐ shuāng tuōxié wǒ dōu xǐhuān, bù zhīdào zěnme tiāoxuǎn? B: Zhè róngyì, nǐ tiāo shuāng piányi de jiù hǎo.
examples.english: A: I like all these pairs of slippers; I don't know how to choose? B: That's easy, just pick a cheap pair.

examples.chinese: 你最好別穿著拖鞋去參加正式活動，要不然別人可能認為你不懂禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo bié chuān zhe tuōxié qù cānjiā zhèngshì huódòng, yàobùrán biérén kěnéng rènwéi nǐ bù dǒng lǐmào.
examples.english: You'd better not wear slippers to attend a formal event, otherwise others might think you don't understand manners.

examples.chinese: 我剛拖了地，地上還是溼的，你最好繞過去比較安全。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng tuō le dì, dìshàng háishì shī de, nǐ zuìhǎo rào guòqù bǐjiào ānquán.
examples.english: I just mopped the floor, and the floor is still wet; you'd better go around it, it's safer.

items.wordHook: a 衤(cloth) pattern rests in the 庫(armory) → sewn into sturdy 褲(pants).
起(rise) + 飛(fly) → rise and fly: 起飛(to take off).
